limitations: Snapshots are moving; reread refs immediately before merging.
Current Mail and Zotero work records explicitly mark final integrated qualification as in progress; preserve and run needed checks locally.

integration_review.merge_recommendation: Integrate Zotero tip once; it is a direct descendant of the captured Mail tip and an ordinary descendant of main. Both histories are preserved with no textual conflict. Refresh all refs before final publication.
integration_review.production_completeness: Mail Archive downstream implementations and tests are present; prior enum-only incomplete checkpoint has been superseded. Both work records still label final integrated qualification as in progress.

confirmed_docx_bug.description: Native physical RTL indentation is written/read as Word direction-relative left/right without normalization. Symmetric native roundtrip masks incorrect external layout. Empty LTR paragraph jc=end is parsed as default left.
affected_paths: sparse imported pPr and inherited bidi/indent semantics
confirmed_docx_bug.consumer_observation: Before-fix primary cohort: 12 successful external saves; original six documents reopen natively; independent XML finds RTL physical indent differences in nine DOCX files. Centered RTL marker displaced approximately 30 pt relative to ODT counterpart.

existing_defensive_limits: LibreOffice adds field-boundary run properties, making retained citation packets opaque/read-only under existing guards.
LibreOffice ODT outline styles are refused by existing numbered/positioned and unknown-attribute guards.
Converter is LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, not stable-release or installed Word/Zotero plugin qualification.
needed_direction_regression_scope: Independent raw-OOXML expected semantics, not only Quds self-roundtrips.
LTR/RTL and explicit false bidi, physical left/right and logical start/end including aliases.
Direction inherited from styles; sparse direct indent sides; firstLine/hanging opposite inheritance clearing.
Preserve untouched native attributes and foreign namespace metadata while emitting changed direction/indent/alignment.
Re-run relevant Word VBA paragraph formatting and provenance-aware serialization tests.
integration_review.review_limit: Read-only code and retained evidence inspection; this audit did not execute new Dart/Flutter tests.
